verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator, so running the same robot code in simulation and on the real robot is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents that portability. The pack shows only ROS install pairing (ros_gz), message transport, and simulated sensor data, none of which states that unchanged robot code can target both simulation and real hardware.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can run the same robot code against simulation and the real robot without a rewrite
